definitions.gloss: enclosure; enclosing (in an envelope or package)
definitions.explanation: The act of including a document or item inside an envelope or package along with the main letter or contents.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}を{同封|どうふう}しました。
{返信用|へんしんよう}の{封筒|ふうとう}を{同封|どうふう}いたします。
examples.english: I am enclosing a return envelope.

examples.japanese: {同封|どうふう}の{資料|しりょう}をご{確認|かくにん}ください。

notes:
{同封|どうふう} is composed of {同|どう} (together, same) and {封|ふう} (seal, envelope). It is used as a する verb: {同封|どうふう}する (to enclose).

This word is primarily used in formal correspondence, both written letters and business communications.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同封|どうふう}する (to enclose)
- {同封|どうふう}の{書類|しょるい} (the enclosed documents)
- 〜を{同封|どうふう}いたします (I am enclosing... — polite business form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {添付|てんぷ}: attachment — used for email attachments ({添付|てんぷ}ファイル)
- {同梱|どうこん}: including in the same package — used for parcels, product bundles
